scope: Additive pre-rollover BAL-ATL gamebook reconciliation. The official final gamebook is now available and binds final participation, overtime duration and every printed injury/return sequence. The pair remains blocked only on governed numerical promotion of the newly exact personnel and QB timelines. No ratings, manifest, current-week overlays, fairs or betting outputs are changed.

sources.finding: Official NFL final gamebook reports Baltimore 30, Atlanta 23 in overtime, 4,023 seconds of elapsed game time, complete lineups/substitutions/DNPs/inactives, and the printed injury/return chronology used below.
Official NFL Week 5 schedule independently reports Baltimore 30, Atlanta 23, FINAL; Buffalo-Los Angeles Rams remains the Monday night game.
Official final inactive lists establish the game-day inactive inventory for both clubs, including Lamar Jackson, Cam Jurgens, Andrew Vorhees, Trey Hendrickson and Za'Darius Smith.
Official final designations distinguish injury-driven outs/questionables from healthy game-day exclusions and identify Yasir Abdullah and Za'Darius Smith as out before the final gamebook.

Baltimore identified Tyler Huntley as the Lamar Jackson injury replacement, Mike Green in the Trey Hendrickson edge role, Olaivavega Ioane at center and Emery Jones Jr. positioned to start at right guard for Andrew Vorhees; Cam Jurgens had not yet debuted for Baltimore.

Current official roster review confirms Ja'Kobi Lane, Danny Pinter, Durham Smythe, T.J. Tampa Jr. and Skylar Thompson on reserve/injured, with Bilhal Kone and Adam Randall on reserve/injured-designated for return. The final gamebook shows none activated for this game.
Atlanta placed Yasir Abdullah on injured reserve and elevated Bralen Trice and Drake Jackson for the depleted edge rotation. The final gamebook lists both elevated edge players as active substitutes.

Atlanta reports Michael Penix Jr. suffered a late fourth-quarter rib injury and Tua Tagovailoa handled the overtime relief. The final gamebook supplies the exact intervening play and return chronology.

BAL Mike Green and Emery Jones Jr. started in the Hendrickson and Vorhees vacancy chains; ATL Bralen Trice and Drake Jackson were active edge substitutes after the Smith and Abdullah absences.
